MICRO_DIAGNOSIS: Financial recorded two separate incidents where correct policy/capability declarations did not make the required behavior happen in the live path: system-impact creation on corrective feedback and proactive evidence recovery before asking the user.
Current UAOS binding validates declaration/reference compatibility but does not itself prove that an inherited cognitive behavior is operational in a child session.
MACRO_GOAL_AND_TOPOLOGY_ALIGNMENT: UAOS should own common semantics and assurance boundaries while registered domains retain business execution, internal state, evidence format and task graphs.
The repair must improve observability without turning UAOS into a per-turn child proxy or microscheduler.
GOVERNING_ASSUMPTION_CHALLENGE: rejected assumption: a capability ID plus compatible binding is sufficient evidence that the behavior executes
rejected assumption: a Financial-specific journal and recovery sequence should be copied into all registered domains
rejected assumption: missing ideal evidence should automatically become a user dependency
EXTERNAL_METHOD_OR_ARCHITECTURE_RESEARCH: Kubernetes liveness/readiness/startup probe model: runtime behavior is probed rather than inferred from configuration presence
Pact code-first contract testing: declared interaction contracts gain assurance from executable consumer/provider behavior verification
COUNTEREXAMPLE_SEARCH: Video uses work orders, invocation paths, evidence contracts and attestation tiers, so a Financial article-journal probe would be structurally wrong.
A-share uses point-in-time freeze/replay and market-day evidence, so common assurance must allow replay evidence rather than prescribe one probe implementation.
Novel uses checkpoint/canon/project evidence and has a lighter capability declaration surface, so the parent must standardize the assurance outcome rather than one internal ledger.
